create_learned_positional_embedding: create a LearnedPositionalEmbedding module with num_embeddings, embedding_dim, and padding_idx parameters
forward_positional_embeddings: run the forward pass on input tensor of size bsz x seqlen to get positional embeddings
forward_incremental_decoding: run forward with incremental_state for single-step decoding during autoregressive generation
forward_precomputed_positions: run forward with pre-computed positions tensor instead of auto-generating position ids
get_max_positions: get the maximum number of supported positions from the LearnedPositionalEmbedding module
